name: Mossy Tumor
summary: Around Wellspring Lake, mossy tumors spread through Teldrassil's timberlings. Cut from their bark and flesh, these poisonous growths show the corruption taking hold in the young World Tree.

sections.title: A Symptom of Teldrassil's Malaise
sections.body: Teldrassil's timberlings once tended the great tree's boughs. Many are now hostile and diseased, and their mossy tumors make that sickness plain. Thick with toxins, the growths spread across Mire Beasts, Tramplers, and Elder Timberlings around Wellspring Lake. Rellian Greenspyre and the keepers in Darnassus send travelers to cut them away and burn them thoroughly. Their poison must not take deeper root in the island's soil.

faq.answer: A Mossy Tumor is a diseased growth cut from a tainted timberling. Its poison shows that an unnatural corruption afflicts Teldrassil's nature spirits.

faq.q: Where do you find Mossy Tumors?
faq.answer: You find Mossy Tumors on corrupted timberlings around Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil. They grow on Timberling Tramplers, Mire Beasts, and Elder Timberlings.

faq.q: Why does Rellian Greenspyre want these tumors?
faq.answer: Rellian Greenspyre gathers the tumors to contain the corruption afflicting Teldrassil. He has them burned to ash so their concentrated poison cannot leach back into the soil and water.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings becoming diseased?
faq.answer: A malevolence is taking hold across Teldrassil, warping its caretakers and wild creatures. The night elves are investigating the sickness's true source, while timberlings with visible tumors are considered beyond saving.

angles.text: As a druid devoted to nature's balance, you may find toxic tumors on plant guardians like timberlings a troubling sign. Something is deeply wrong with Teldrassil.
As a night elf, you know your people planted Teldrassil to restore their lost bond with nature. Diseased growths on your new home are a troubling omen.
